name: GlitchText-TS-TW
blurb: Text glitches with clipped overlays in cyan and red, like a VHS artifact.
description: Renders text with CSS-animated pseudo-elements that clip and shift horizontally, creating a glitch effect with optional color shadows. Triggers continuously or on hover.
use_when: A bold headline wants a cyberpunk or corrupted aesthetic that signals digital distortion.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical content or when constant motion might distract from readability.
a11y: Text is readable in the main element; glitch overlays are hidden with aria-hidden. No keyboard interaction.
